object.definition: The public compact convex set $X\subset\mathbb R^d$ contains the origin and has Euclidean diameter at most $D$. Losses are differentiable and convex and satisfy $\|\nabla f_t(x)\|_2\le G$. The environment may depend on past history but cannot anticipate current private randomness.

operation.query_signature: Submit the final master action $x_t\in X$ and receive one exact gradient there. Internal experts do not query gradients at their own actions. Euclidean projection onto $X$ is allowed. The policy is causal and independent of the comparator and path budget. Inputs $T,X,D,G$ are public; path $u_{1:T}$ and its Euclidean length are hidden. Past feedback may be stored and reused computationally; no additional historical or sample queries are available beyond the explicitly declared interface.

steps: Each round submits the final principal action $x_t\in X$ before receiving its one exact gradient. Internal experts do not separately query gradients at their own actions.
Euclidean projection onto $X$ is available. The learner is causal and cannot depend on the comparator or its path budget.
The data $T,X,D,G$ are public. The comparator path $u_{1:T}$ and its total Euclidean length are hidden.

Received feedback may be stored and reused in computation. Unrevealed information cannot be requested from past rounds, and consumed random samples cannot receive additional queries. Current-round exceptions are limited to the explicitly supplied full-function access or same-sample two-point interface.
